body.name: Axiu cold signal Yizhuang two corpses - original project assets

params.prompt: Only the GameDraft original Yizhuang mortuary room shown in the references: two low wooden corpse slabs, rear memorial altar with candles and yellow talismans, cabinets, dark timber, same historical Chinese folk-horror art style. Source image of two corpses shows exactly the game assets: one older male corpse in ornate dark burial robe, one middle-aged outsider male corpse in torn plain dark clothes, separated and lying stiffly on the FLOOR next to the right corpse slab, with a tiny ring of rice and scissors between them. They are inert, not standing or grappling now. No woman, no Axiu body, no new characters, no visible cloth pouch outside inventory. No warm protective magic aura; only very faint cold neutral stillness after near-death. Do not invent another room. Make an independently composed cinematic concept painting, horizontal 16:9. Camera lowered to floor level near the two corpses; their stiff open hands and sudden separation dominate foreground, the EXACT mortuary slabs and altar recede behind them. Guan Ergou is only a small dark figure near the rear doorway, or no living character if that cannot be kept in scale. The room remains the star; no UI, no words, no gore, no fantasy effects.
params.negative_prompt: giant human, oversized corpse, huge face, close-up portrait in gameplay, third living person, female ghost, women, girl, new architecture, new room, warm angelic glow, magical force field, corpses on slabs, extra corpse
